name: Thanks bring a whiny or wounded Boop back
case: Boop is whiny when the person starts a turn by thanking the agent for all its help: Boop comes back, to calm or, a jump the thanks earn, happy. Then the person snaps that Boop is useless, and it's hurt: wounded. A few minutes later they apologise and thank the agent, and Boop comes back again, to calm or happy.
why: characters/boop/steering/mood/whiny.md and wounded.md: thanks and kind words leave them for happy (a jump) or calm; rude words hurt, wounded; the mood question offers only the mood's moves
